phase: C6 / C4 investigation — CORRECTED after review
prior_error_corrected: An earlier version of this file claimed the 6 two-sided disagreements were usability SUB-QUERIES that 'change no judgment'. That was WRONG. They are FINAL judgments, and under a complete integer solver the reported counts would differ (in the safe/conservative direction). Corrected below.
summary: Of 37,582 live omega queries, 6 disagree: ALL are (Lean omega = NOT_PROVEN, z3-Int = ENTAILED). They are FINAL judgments, not sub-queries: 5 are RECORD_CONCLUSIONs (feed M1 redundancy) and 1 is an ARCHIVE_CONCLUSION that is one of the 3 reported 'C3 failures'.
root_cause: Lean's `omega` TACTIC is practically INCOMPLETE on INTEGER-SPECIFIC entailments. MEASURED: all 6 are z3-Int=ENTAILED but z3-Real=REFUTED (they fail over the rationals and hold only over the integers — they need integrality/cutting-plane reasoning). omega is supposed to decide exactly this but fails: even after reducing to z3's minimal UNSAT CORE, 4 of 6 still fail omega (e.g. #2 fails on a 4-fact core).
independent_confirmation_z3_is_right: For #2 (4-fact core): exhaustive integer brute force over [-30,30]^4 finds NO counterexample; z3 bounded [-30,30] = unsat; z3 unbounded = unsat. So the entailment is genuinely TRUE over Z and omega (not z3) is the one that fails. z3 is a TRUSTWORTHY cross-check here.
soundness: INTACT. omega failing -> NOT_PROVEN is conservative: it can only keep a (really-redundant) record or mark an (actually-re-derivable) archive prop as a failure — never a false PROVEN, never a deleted true theorem. Dangerous direction (Lean PROVEN but z3 refutes) = 0 occurrences. The 4,470 PROVEN all carry a Lean certificate AND z3 confirmation.

impact_on_reported_numbers.reported_are_conservative_Lean_certified: M1=20, C3=228 are the Lean-CERTIFIED counts (every positive has an omega proof). They match v1.4.7 exactly because v1.4.7 used the same omega (same conservatism).
impact_on_reported_numbers.complete_solver_counts_would_be: z3 (complete for LIA) indicates the COMPLETE answer is larger: up to M1=25 (the 5 RECORD_CONCLUSION entailments omega missed) and C3=229 (the 1 ARCHIVE entailment omega missed). Those extra 6 lack a Lean certificate (omega cannot produce one), so they are conservatively excluded from the certified counts.
impact_on_reported_numbers.errata_param_gap_correction: At least 1 of the 3 reported 'C3 param-gap failures' (`if (is_regular(2) and m<=6) then 4*alpha>=3*n-3*chi-1`) is actually z3-ENTAILED from the same facts; it is an OMEGA-INCOMPLETENESS artifact, not (only) a parameter gap. errata.json is corrected accordingly.

core_reduction_improvement: Feeding omega z3's minimal unsat core (instead of all 29-70 hypotheses) RECOVERS a Lean certificate for 2 of the 6 (#0: 55->10 facts, #1: 29->2 facts -> omega PROVEN). A core-reduced proof is a valid certificate (core subset of facts, so core->goal implies facts->goal). This is an available matrix improvement (retry-omega-with-z3-core); the remaining 4 fail omega even on the minimal core and stay conservative.
